analyze_FlopAnalyzer_total: analyze a PyTorch model to get the total flop count using FlopAnalyzer
analyze_FlopAnalyzer_by_operator: analyze a PyTorch model to get flop counts broken down by operator type
analyze_ActivationAnalyzer_total: analyze a PyTorch model to get the total activation count using ActivationAnalyzer
run_flop_count: run flop_count on a PyTorch model to get per-operator GFLOPs and unsupported ops
run_parameter_count_table: run parameter_count_table on a PyTorch model to print a formatted parameter count table
